About this prototype

This demo stores changes only in page memory. It has no shared database, login, reminders or email sending. Copying a draft does not send it. “Record sent” documents a message sent elsewhere. Excel files are parsed locally; downloads contain the selected cases. Use fictional data to explore the workflow. Spreadsheet parsing: SheetJS CE licence.
